VI.description: Round21 nested-chain top: calls Sum Of Doubles.vi, which itself calls Double It.vi - a three-level Call chain (nested Calls, depth 2 under the top). Expected outputs, hand-computed: Sum = 2+4+...+2N = N*(N+1), Count = N; N=3 gives Sum 12 / Count 3, N=4 gives Sum 20 / Count 4. Panel: N in (conIdx0, required), Sum out (conIdx1, recommended), Count out (conIdx2, recommended). Call output net ids are their own numbers (4310/4311, not the Call's uid 4200), per the round-6 recipe.
